# Historical v5e: 168-shape matrix study

This is the completed September 21 study, exported without new TPU measurements. All five families use BF16 inputs and FP32 accumulation/output. Original screen selections are retained; confirmation does not reselect a winner. This archive contains no v6e or LLM measurements.

All 25 main-study phase audits passed, including deterministic confidence-interval replay for all 12 confirmation phases. Every copied bundle member was checked against its original bytes. Numerical references are not rerun by this archive audit.
